baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same ش ي ء verb occurs with the human plural at word 2 and with Allah at word 5, joined by the exceptive construction إلا أن.
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated lexeme keeps human willing semantically real while the exception makes its occurrence dependent on divine willing. The title رب adds administration and nurture, so dependence need not mean that the subordinate act is fictive.

activation_trace.role: Will directed toward a thing supplies the shared action on both sides of the exception and lets syntax, rather than two unrelated senses, establish the asymmetry.
Repair, nurture, and stagewise completion make lordship the sustaining administration within which a finite will can become operative.

changed_reading.before: The verse simply cancels human will with a stronger divine will.
changed_reading.after: The verse nests a real human willing inside the divine willing that sustains and conditions it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled شاء construction changes subject across the exception while retaining one object-oriented root image.
baseline_models.mechanism: The branch inventory allows willing to range from choosing a knowable thing to bringing it about or attaining it according to the agent. The construction can therefore distinguish finite orientation toward an outcome from the divine condition under which an outcome and the act of intending it become actual.

activation_trace.role: The knowable thing supplies a common intended object, keeping the double willing tethered to an outcome rather than treating will as an empty force.
Will toward a thing includes choosing and, by scope, possible bringing-about, enabling an intention-versus-actualization asymmetry between the two subjects.
Lordship, ownership, and authority assign final efficacy to Allah without erasing the subordinate subject named before the exception.

changed_reading.before: Two wills compete as quantities on one scale.
changed_reading.after: Human willing can name orientation toward an outcome, while divine willing names the encompassing condition of its actuality and efficacy.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Allah is immediately expanded by رب العالمين after the exception.
baseline_models.mechanism: The proper name and two titles prevent the condition from remaining an impersonal causal ceiling. The condition belongs to the worshipped Lord whose authority extends across every knowable or sign-marked domain, making human willing a situated response within a devotional relation.

activation_trace.role: Worship and the worshipped one turn the conditioning agent from an anonymous cause into the addressee of devotion and response.
Lordship and authority define the governing relation in which the human act of willing is located.
A distinguishing mark that guides toward something lets the worlds function as differentiated, sign-bearing domains under one Lord.

changed_reading.before: The final title merely enlarges the scale of an abstract decree.
changed_reading.after: The title locates conditioned human willing inside a personal relation of worship, governance, and sign-filled creaturely life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence repeatedly removes the apparent stability of created systems: a luminous body is rolled together, mountains are displaced, prized resources are left functionless, and the sky-cover is stripped away. The named divine subject in 81:29 can then be heard retroactively as the sustaining agency beneath those passive reversals, with human willing included among dependent created operations rather than uniquely declared unreal.

activation_trace.role: Rolling and gathering a thing upon itself supplies the first collapse of an apparently stable cosmic arrangement.
Removal and displacement make even the mountains' fixedness a contingent arrangement.
Vacancy and suspension show a valued created capacity becoming inoperative when its order is withdrawn.
Removing a cover and exposing what was hidden turns cosmic unmaking into disclosure of dependence.
The shared willing image places human volition inside the same final dependency test applied to other created operations.
Lordship and authority identify the final named governor after the long passive sequence.

structural_cues: 81:1-13 forms a chain of إذا clauses dominated by passive transformations before any final agent is named.
81:29 ends the surah with an explicit divine subject and titles after the created order has been shown reversible.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies passive cosmic reversals and branch images of rolling, displacement, suspension, and uncovering; I infer that the final named subject retroactively grounds their contingency and include human willing in that pattern. A live alternative is that the scenes provide only eschatological scale, without identifying a common causal structure.

changed_reading.before: The exception is an isolated metaphysical qualification attached only to human choice.
changed_reading.after: The exception climaxes a surah-wide demonstration that every created capacity operates within a reversible order sustained by the Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the passive upheavals, a self actively knows what it has made present; immediately before 81:29, a human addressee can will to rise into straightness. This sequence differentiates levels of agency: divine willing conditions the field, but finite willing and bringing remain attributable enough for recognition and accountability.

activation_trace.role: A thing becoming clear to a knower supplies the self-recognition that follows the passive transformations.
The very self or entity anchors knowledge and responsibility in a finite subject rather than dissolving that subject.
Presence, witnessing, and nearness turn what the self brought into evidence now confronting it.
Will toward a thing explicitly assigns an upright-directed choice to members of the human audience.
Resolve and rising toward a matter make straightening an initiated movement, not a merely static label.
Straightness, balance, and levelness specify the direction to which that finite resolve is answerable.
Repeating the same willing image preserves human attribution while making it conditionally nested.

structural_cues: The discourse pivots at 81:14 from passive cosmic events to a finite subject that knows what it brought.
The human willing of 81:28 is asserted immediately before, not deleted by, its qualification in 81:29.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an active knowing self, what it has brought present, and a human will aimed at straightness; I infer that conditioned agency remains attributable and answerable. The alternative is that these are only phenomenological attributions within an exhaustive divine determination.

changed_reading.before: Dependence on divine will functions as an excuse that empties finite agency of attribution.
changed_reading.after: Dependence and accountability coexist: the conditioned self still wills, brings, recognizes, and answers for its direction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Questioning over a killing, written sheets opened out, and each self knowing what it brought form an evidentiary sequence. Against that sequence, the final qualification of willing does not erase intent; it places intent inside the Lord's jurisdiction where concealed acts and their reasons become present and legible.

activation_trace.role: Exchanged questioning supplies an interrogative proceeding in which a suppressed wrong is made answerable.
Sin or culpability makes the question concern moral cause rather than bare event description.
Taking life fixes the concrete harm around which culpable intention is investigated.
The written sheet supplies a durable record rather than an evanescent accusation.
Opening, spreading, and branching out turn the record into publicly inspectable evidence.
Disclosure to the knower internalizes the evidence as recognition by the responsible self.
Presence and witnessing convert prior conduct into something brought before judgment.
Lordship and authority supply the jurisdiction within which finite willing remains evidence despite its dependence.
Distinguishing marks make the governed worlds legible fields in which acts and intentions can be identified.

structural_cues: 81:8's branchless و ء د cue identifies the silenced victim as the questioned party; it is used only as a structural reversal and receives no invented branch citation.
The sequence moves from question and offense to opened records and finally to the self's own knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies questioning, culpability, killing, written sheets, opening, knowing, and presence; I infer an evidentiary or juridical chain in which willing remains attributable. A live alternative is disclosure without a formal courtroom mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The divine condition makes human intention irrelevant to judgment.
changed_reading.after: Human intention is dependent yet evidentiary: it is disclosed, recorded, and judged within divine lordship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The second half constructs a reliable opening from hiddenness into perception and speech: dawn opens, a messenger conveys speech, the channel is secure, something is shown on a clarifying horizon, the unseen is not withheld, and the reminder addresses whoever wills. Divine willing in 81:29 can thus be heard not only as a prior limit but as the prior making-available of a signal that human attention and desire can answer.

activation_trace.role: The opening of dawn like breath supplies a transition from enclosure into perceptible possibility.
Speech brought out in utterance gives the newly opened field communicable content.
Messenger and message supply the mediating channel rather than an unaddressed inner impulse.
Security and settled trust make the mediating channel reliable enough to ground response.
Showing and making manifest supply a movement from transmitted claim into disclosed perception.
Clarifying meaning by speech or sign makes the manifestation direction-bearing rather than merely spectacular.
What is screened from sight defines the informational boundary that revelation crosses.
The ayah negates withholding and stinginess, so this branch contributes active non-withholding to the disclosure mechanism.
A reminder that makes one remember names the disclosed message's function in awakening response.
Close listening activates an attentional layer inside the human willing immediately addressed by the reminder.
Being drawn toward something recasts willing as responsive attraction made possible by what has been disclosed.
Nurturing and completion let the Lord's will include formation of the conditions for hearing and response.

structural_cues: 81:19-25 repeatedly verifies speaker, channel, sighting, disclosure, and exclusion of corrupt attribution.
81:27-28 places the universal reminder directly before the willing to become straight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opening, utterance, messenger, trust, manifestation, clarification, non-withholding, reminder, and attentive or attracted willing; I infer that divine willing enables response by making guidance available and affectively audible. The alternative is that communicative access and the final divine condition are adjacent but causally independent.

changed_reading.before: Divine willing is only an opaque decree imposed before any human response.
changed_reading.after: Divine willing can also name the prior opening, transmission, and attraction through which a human will becomes able to answer guidance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The last four ayat form a navigation sequence: a challenge about where one is going, a reminder for the worlds, a will to become straight, and then the condition of the Lord's will. The final condition can therefore function as the route's support and governing alignment, not as a late cancellation of movement already invited.

activation_trace.role: A way, place, or adopted path turns the rhetorical going into a question of route.
A document or warrant of right gives the reminder a norm against which a route can be evaluated.
A distinguishing mark that guides supplies landmarks across the worlds addressed by the reminder.
Will toward a thing supplies the traveler's real orientation toward the offered straight route.
Straightness and balance define the route's directional norm.
Support, sustaining structure, and livelihood turn straightness into a trajectory needing ongoing upholding.
The doubled willing places the traveler's orientation inside the will that makes the route viable.
Repair, nurture, and completion supply the route's continuing maintenance rather than a one-time permission.
Sign-bearing worlds make the Lord's universal scope also a field of navigable marks.

structural_cues: 81:26 asks for a destination, 81:27 supplies guidance, 81:28 names willing and straightening, and 81:29 names the sustaining condition.
The second-person plural continues across the question of going and the statement about willing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies path, warrant, guiding mark, willing, straightness, support, and nurture; I infer a directional chain in which divine will sustains rather than aborts the invited journey. The live alternative is that path language is only a conventional moral metaphor and adds no causal account of the final exception.

changed_reading.before: The last ayah interrupts the invitation to choose straightness with a contradictory restriction.
changed_reading.after: The last ayah completes the navigation model: choosing the route is real, but no upright trajectory supplies its own landmarks, alignment, or support.

context_deltas.mechanism: Knowing, seeing at a distant horizon, clarification, and reminder repeatedly turn hidden reality into a recognizable sign. The final العالمين can consequently carry more than universal extent: it closes an epistemic circuit in which the Lord governs differentiated worlds that mark and disclose the direction toward which one may will.

activation_trace.role: A thing becoming clear to the knower begins the context's explicit epistemic arc.
Vision by eye or insight supplies direct recognition within that arc.
Distant horizons extend disclosure across a bounded field of view rather than confining it to inward knowledge.
Appearance and uncovering make the horizon an explicit site of manifestation.
Bringing something back into presence after forgetfulness turns disclosure into retained orientation.
A distinguishing mark that points onward activates العالمين as domains legible through signs.
The same guiding-mark image makes the closing title gather the preceding knowledge and manifestation sequence.
Nurturing administration makes the Lord governor not only of beings but of their capacity to become intelligible signs.

structural_cues: The root ع ل م appears at the self's knowing in 81:14, in the reminder's audience at 81:27, and in the closing title at 81:29.
The clear horizon and the reminder intervene between first-person seeing and second-person willing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies knowing, vision, horizon, manifestation, recollection, and mark-images around repeated ع ل م; I infer that the closing worlds are sign-bearing fields that make directed willing epistemically possible. The alternative is that العالمين is only a collective noun and the mark branch is evocative rather than operative.

changed_reading.before: Lord of the worlds is an ornamental statement of maximal scope.
changed_reading.after: Lord of the worlds also closes a sign-and-knowledge circuit: the One conditioning will governs the fields through which a direction becomes knowable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context gathers creatures, pairs or classifies selves, then makes each self know what it brought before addressing a plural 'you' who will. This opens a social reading in which willing is personally attributable but not atomically private: selves are constituted, sorted, and disclosed in relation to companions, kinds, and a common destination.

activation_trace.role: Driving and gathering a group toward one destination supplies the common field in which individual direction is tested.
The self as the very entity preserves personal identity inside the collective gathering.
Peers gathered by shared form or work supply a classificatory and social relation among selves.
Mind and inward awareness preserve an interior center that recognizes what it brought.
The plural human willing remains the focus anchor while the shared image locates all such wills within one encompassing condition.
Knowable worlds provide the widest common domain in which distinct selves and their directions become disclosed.

structural_cues: The focus uses a second-person plural verb and closes with a plural worlds-title.
The context alternates collective gatherings with the singular نفس that knows its own bringing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, selfhood, pairing by kind or work, inward awareness, and plural address; I infer that willing is relationally situated while remaining personally attributable. The alternative is that the pairings concern only eschatological sorting and do not modify the psychology of 81:29.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes an isolated individual's private faculty of choice.
changed_reading.after: The verse can address wills that are personal yet socially situated, gathered, paired, and disclosed within a shared world-order.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the branch-distant young-palm image of ش ي ء and the non-dominant ر ب و mapping of رب; it remains anchored in the focus roots and is reinforced by nurture, opening dawn, and supporting qiwam. Downstream prose should present it only as a developmental image activation, never as a lexical replacement for شاء or رب.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The human and divine شاء forms stand beside رب, whose mapped inventories include both stagewise nurture and growth.

activation_trace.role: Young palm shoots supply a deliberately branch-distant image for a nascent capacity to will that requires cultivation.
Repair, nurture, and stagewise completion give the Lord's relation a developmental mechanism.
The non-dominant mapped branch of feeding and growing up intensifies the image of volitional capacity being cultivated.
Dawn opening like breath supplies the environmental release in which new directed capacity can emerge.
Support and sustaining structure give the cultivated capacity an upright form rather than mere growth.

changed_reading.before: Willing is a finished possession that is either independently present or absent.
changed_reading.after: Willing can be imagined as a tender, cultivated capacity that opens and stands through the Lord's ongoing nurture.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the driving branch of ش ي ء is form-distant from ordinary شاء and can sound coercive; it remains anchored by the doubled focus verb and by contextual images of inward facilitation, resolve, and resistance. Downstream prose should frame it as a tension model about vectors acting on willing, not claim that the verse lexically means compulsion.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The exception joins two occurrences of شاء while رب supplies a formative relation, allowing pressure, enablement, and response to be tested without replacing the ordinary will sense.

activation_trace.role: Driving something toward a matter introduces a pressure vector inside the shared root field of willing.
Nurture and completion keep the encompassing vector formative rather than reducing it automatically to force.
Making the self easy or ready for a matter supplies an enabling vector distinct from external compulsion.
Resolve and rising toward the matter preserve initiated response within the field of enablement.
Resistance and contest preserve the possibility of counter-pressure rather than a frictionless mechanical outcome.

changed_reading.before: The verse permits only a binary choice between autonomous freedom and total coercion.
changed_reading.after: The verse can sustain a dynamic field of formation, facilitation, resolve, and resistance in which dependence does not settle the mode of influence.

strongest_changes: The passive cosmic reversals make conditioned human willing one instance of universal creaturely dependence, not a uniquely unreal act.
The active knowing self and the will to straighten preserve attribution and accountability inside that dependence.
The verified disclosure sequence activates divine willing as making guidance available, audible, and attractive to response.
The closing route sequence makes divine willing the landmarks, alignment, and support of upright movement rather than a cancellation of the invitation.
summary.what_was_special: The focus repeats the same willing root across the exception and then adds Lord and worlds; the context repeatedly prepares both sides of that construction through reversals of created order, recovered finite agency, opened records, trustworthy mediation, route language, and a sign-and-knowledge chain. These activations support several coexisting mechanisms rather than one resolution of the freedom question.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus does not decide whether the asymmetry concerns the existence of human willing, its efficacy, its object, or all three.
The legal, communicative, navigational, epistemic, and relational mechanisms can coexist, but the packet alone does not rank their causal force.
The growth, close-listening, attraction, and pressure activations are visibly rooted but branch-distant and require explicit exploratory qualification.
The non-dominant ر ب و mapping enriches nurture and growth but cannot by itself control the ordinary reading of رب.
